rankings.summaryHtml: An update for you omen-trackers: Golden State is just the ninth team in NBA history to win at least 36 of its first 42 games. Good omen: The first six teams to do so all went on to win a championship that season. Bad omen: The last two -- Detroit in 2005-06 and San Antonio in 2010-11 -- did not.
